name: Public S3 Bucket Lockdown & Data Exfiltration Mitigation
description: Automated remediation for S3 buckets exposed to the public internet or exhibiting anomalous large-scale object exfiltration patterns.

mitre_attack.technique: Exfiltration Over Web Service: Exfiltration to Cloud Storage

actions.name: ApplyBucketPublicAccessBlock
actions.description: Enforces all 4 Amazon S3 Public Access Block settings: BlockPublicAcls, IgnorePublicAcls, BlockPublicPolicy, RestrictPublicBuckets.

actions.name: ResetBucketAclToPrivate
actions.description: Replaces public or authenticated-users grants with private bucket ACL.

actions.name: ApplyQuarantineBucketPolicy
actions.description: Overwrites or amends bucket policy to restrict read/write access solely to AWS account root or approved administrative roles over TLS.

actions.name: RecordRemediationAuditEvidence
actions.description: Captures pre- and post-remediation bucket configuration and stores tamper-evident evidence in S3 evidence vault.

actions.name: DispatchSecOpsAlert
actions.description: Sends immediate notification to cloud operations and data governance teams detailing the remediated bucket.

recovery_procedure: Verify whether sensitive PII or corporate data was accessed while the bucket was publicly accessible via S3 server access logs / CloudTrail data events.
Engage data owner to establish approved least-privilege bucket policy if external partner sharing is required.
